C-GATE-RECORD-ABSENCE.Summary: Distinguish pre-gate archive absence of a Decisions section from a genuine applied-without-gate-record violation (A33.1 / correction 69).
C-GATE-RECORD-ABSENCE.Problem:
After Phase 5 shipped apply-gate recording, ngrace status flagged every archived applied bundle that predated the gate surface with applied-without-gate-record. C-ABSENCE-VALUE, C-RUN-LEDGER, and C-ATTEMPT-LOG can never clear that finding — they were applied before Decisions existed. The signal is permanently on for reasons the reader cannot act on (A17.2 from the other side), so a bundle that genuinely skipped its gate is indistinguishable from the three older ones.
The code already separates permit | absent | invalid on applyGateRecord, but absent and no-permit both pushed applied-without-gate-record. Correction 69 gives absent its own state and reason.

Goals.Goal: No Decisions section on an archived applied bundle reports apply-gate-record-absent with an explicit reason (may predate the gate), never applied-without-gate-record.
A Decisions section that exists without a permitting apply still reports applied-without-gate-record (the designed violation).
Invalid Decisions still reports gate-record-invalid:<code>; a clean gated archive reports neither finding (states=none for gate-record diagnostics).
No archived Phase 2–4 artifact is edited; grandfathering is by construction.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not reopen or rewrite C-GATE-SURFACE or older archived bundles.
Gate this bundle's own close-out through ngrace gate (lifecycle as designed).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Retroactively writing Decisions into pre-gate archives.
Changing exit-code policy for status integrity warnings.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ABSENT-NOT-VIOLATION: Archived applied bundles with no Decisions section derive apply-gate-record-absent, not applied-without-gate-record (A33.1).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SECTION-WITHOUT-PERMIT: A present Decisions section without a permitting apply Decision still derives applied-without-gate-record.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-INVALID-AND-CLEAN: Invalid Decisions derives gate-record-invalid; a gated archive with apply permit has neither finding.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPO-STATUS: ngrace status --path . on this repository shows the three pre-gate archives under apply-gate-record-absent and C-GATE-SURFACE under states=none for gate findings.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Status unit tests for four cases; ngrace status on this repo; validate:ci green.
